terms.definition: Frappe HR employee master record combining person identity and active employment.
terms.label: Employee

terms.definition: Frappe HR hierarchical organizational department.
terms.label: Department

terms.definition: Frappe HR job title or post designation.
terms.label: Designation

terms.definition: Frappe HR physical work location or operating site assigned to employees.
terms.label: Branch

terms.definition: Frappe HR employment contract classification such as full-time, part-time, intern, or contract.
terms.label: Employment Type

terms.definition: Frappe HR seniority or compensation band associated with default leave policies and salary structures.
terms.label: Employee Grade

terms.definition: Frappe HR named group of employees used for scheduling, holiday overrides, and payroll or policy targeting.
terms.label: Employee Group

terms.definition: Frappe HR v16 catalog classification of required employee identification, compliance, and personnel documents (superseding legacy Identification Document Type).
terms.label: Employee Document Type

terms.definition: Frappe HR document recording a role, grade, or compensation promotion for an employee.
terms.label: Employee Promotion

terms.definition: Frappe HR document recording an employee move across departments, branches, or legal entities.
terms.label: Employee Transfer

terms.definition: Frappe HR formal employee complaint case tracked through investigation and resolution.
terms.label: Employee Grievance

terms.definition: Frappe HR catalog classification of leave rules including caps, carry-forward, LWP, and encashment policy.
terms.label: Leave Type

terms.definition: Frappe HR template pairing Leave Types with annual entitlement quotas.
terms.label: Leave Policy

terms.definition: Frappe HR document assigning a Leave Policy to an employee for a leave period or effective date.
terms.label: Leave Policy Assignment

terms.definition: Frappe HR fiscal or annual date window governing leave grant cycles and carry-forward expiry.
terms.label: Leave Period

terms.definition: Frappe HR period entitlement of leave days allocated to an employee.
terms.label: Leave Allocation

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee request for leave over a date interval.
terms.label: Leave Application

terms.definition: Frappe HR signed leave movement record posting credits, debits, encashments, and carry-forward expiries.
terms.label: Leave Ledger Entry

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee request to earn compensatory leave days in exchange for work performed on a holiday or off day.
terms.label: Compensatory Leave Request

terms.definition: Frappe HR document converting eligible unused leave balance into a cash payroll earning.
terms.label: Leave Encashment

terms.definition: Frappe HR blackout calendar restricting leave applications on specified dates with optional allow-listed approvers.
terms.label: Leave Block List

terms.definition: Frappe HR calendar of public holidays and weekly off days.
terms.label: Holiday List

terms.definition: One holiday or weekly-off date row inside a Holiday List.
terms.label: Holiday

terms.definition: Frappe HR v16 effective-dated document assigning a Holiday List calendar to an Employee or Company from a given date (superseding the legacy Employee holiday_list field).
terms.label: Holiday List Assignment

terms.definition: Frappe HR recurring local wall-clock shift window definition.
terms.label: Shift Type

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee or manager request to change or assign a shift over a date range.
terms.label: Shift Request

terms.definition: Frappe HR scheduled shift assigned to an employee over a date range.
terms.label: Shift Assignment

terms.definition: Frappe HR raw timestamped time-punch observation captured from biometric, mobile, or manual entry.
terms.label: Employee Checkin

terms.definition: Frappe HR posted daily attendance record for an employee.
terms.label: Attendance

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee request to regularize or submit missed attendance.
terms.label: Attendance Request

terms.definition: Frappe HR atomic earning or deduction pay element with accounting and tax flags.
terms.label: Salary Component

terms.definition: Frappe HR compensation template grouping earning and deduction Salary Components for a pay frequency.
terms.label: Salary Structure

terms.definition: Frappe HR effective-dated assignment binding an employee to a Salary Structure, base pay, and tax slab.
terms.label: Salary Structure Assignment

terms.definition: Frappe HR tax and payroll year interval governing cumulative tax calculation and benefit ceilings.
terms.label: Payroll Period

terms.definition: Frappe HR batch payroll run generating Salary Slips and posting aggregate accrual and bank entries.
terms.label: Payroll Entry

terms.definition: Frappe HR individual employee pay period statement computing gross earnings, deductions, and net payable.
terms.label: Salary Slip

terms.definition: Frappe HR ad-hoc or recurring off-structure earning or deduction injected into a Salary Slip.
terms.label: Additional Salary

terms.definition: Frappe HR progressive statutory tax bracket schedule and standard exemption table.
terms.label: Income Tax Slab

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee declaration of expected tax-exempt investments or allowances for a payroll period.
terms.label: Employee Tax Exemption Declaration

terms.definition: Frappe HR verified documentary proof supporting claimed tax exemptions at tax-period reconciliation.
terms.label: Employee Tax Exemption Proof Submission

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee election allocating flexible compensation allowance across eligible benefit components.
terms.label: Employee Benefit Application

terms.definition: Frappe HR end-of-service gratuity settlement calculated from service tenure and applicable gratuity rule.
terms.label: Gratuity

terms.definition: Frappe HR exit settlement reconciling remaining payables, leave encashment, gratuity, loans, advances, and asset returns.
terms.label: Full and Final Statement

terms.definition: Frappe HR employee reimbursement request for out-of-pocket business expenses.
terms.label: Expense Claim

terms.definition: Frappe HR expense category mapping claim lines to default expense accounts.
terms.label: Expense Claim Type

terms.definition: Frappe HR pre-disbursed cash advance issued to an employee and settled via expense claims or cash return.
terms.label: Employee Advance

terms.definition: Frappe HR pre-travel authorization capturing itinerary, purpose, and estimated travel costs.
terms.label: Travel Request

terms.definition: Frappe HR published vacancy requisition for a target designation and organizational scope.
terms.label: Job Opening

terms.definition: Frappe HR candidate application record tracking a person through recruitment stages for a Job Opening.
terms.label: Job Applicant

terms.definition: Frappe HR v16 revamped formal employment offer extending proposed role, compensation terms, and acceptance workflow to a Job Applicant.
terms.label: Job Offer

terms.definition: Frappe HR formal employment appointment letter issued to a hired candidate detailing binding joining date and contractual terms.
terms.label: Appointment Letter

terms.definition: Frappe HR pre-hire and joining checklist process transitioning an accepted Job Offer into active employment.
terms.label: Employee Onboarding

terms.definition: Frappe HR offboarding checklist process coordinating exit clearance and final settlement.
terms.label: Employee Separation

terms.definition: Frappe HR structured performance review scoring employee KRAs, goals, and peer/manager feedback.
terms.label: Appraisal

terms.definition: Frappe HR time-bounded review cycle coordinating appraisals across an eligible employee cohort.
terms.label: Appraisal Cycle

terms.definition: Frappe HR measurable performance objective linked to an employee, KRA, and appraisal cycle.
terms.label: Goal

terms.definition: Frappe HR scheduled training session specifying trainer, attendees, and session window.
terms.label: Training Event

terms.definition: Frappe HR post-session evaluation recording completed training hours and grades per attendee.
terms.label: Training Result

terms.definition: Submit an Employee Promotion, updating Employee master properties in place and appending an internal work history row.

terms.definition: Submit an Employee Transfer across organizational units or companies, updating Employee master placement.

terms.definition: Record investigation outcome and close a submitted Employee Grievance.

terms.definition: Submit a Leave Policy Assignment and materialize period Leave Allocations for each policy leave type.
terms.label: Grant Leave Policy Assignment

terms.definition: Submit a Leave Allocation and post a credit Leave Ledger Entry.
terms.label: Submit Leave Allocation

terms.definition: Submit a Leave Application in Approved or Rejected status, posting a leave ledger debit when approved.
terms.label: Submit Leave Application

terms.definition: Cancel a submitted Leave Application and reverse its leave ledger entry.
terms.label: Cancel Leave Application

terms.definition: Submit a Compensatory Leave Request to credit compensatory leave days for holiday work.
terms.label: Submit Compensatory Leave Request

terms.definition: Submit a Leave Encashment, debiting leave ledger balance and creating an Additional Salary payout.
terms.label: Submit Leave Encashment

terms.definition: Submit an effective-dated Holiday List Assignment binding an Employee or Company to a Holiday List calendar.
terms.label: Submit Holiday List Assignment

terms.definition: Approve and submit a Shift Request, creating the corresponding Shift Assignment.
terms.label: Submit Shift Request

terms.definition: Submit an active Shift Assignment scheduling an employee into a Shift Type.
terms.label: Submit Shift Assignment

terms.definition: Batch-evaluate Employee Checkin logs for a Shift Type to generate posted daily Attendance records.
terms.label: Process Auto Attendance

terms.definition: Submit an Attendance Request to regularize missed or remote work days by creating or updating Attendance.
terms.label: Submit Attendance Request

terms.definition: Cancel a submitted Attendance document and create a separate replacement document linked via amended_from in place of an immutable reversing economic event.
terms.label: Cancel and amend Attendance

terms.definition: Generate draft Salary Slips for all eligible employees included in a Payroll Entry.
terms.label: Create Salary Slips

terms.definition: Submit all Salary Slips in a Payroll Entry and post payroll accrual journal entries.
terms.label: Submit Payroll Salary Slips

terms.definition: Create the bank disbursement journal entry settling accrued payroll payable.
terms.label: Make Payroll Bank Entry

terms.definition: Finalize a Salary Slip, locking computed earnings, deductions, and net pay for the period.
terms.label: Submit Salary Slip

terms.definition: Cancel a submitted Salary Slip and create a separate replacement document linked via amended_from in place of an immutable reversing/retro-adjustment economic event.
terms.label: Cancel and amend Salary Slip

terms.definition: Submit a Gratuity settlement, generating an Additional Salary or payable journal entry.
terms.label: Submit Gratuity

terms.definition: Finalize a separating employee's Full and Final Statement reconciling payables, recoveries, and clearances.
terms.label: Submit Full and Final Statement

terms.definition: Submit an approved Expense Claim, posting expense ledger entries and employee payable or advance offset.
terms.label: Submit Expense Claim

terms.definition: Submit an approved Employee Advance authorizing cash disbursement to the employee.
terms.label: Submit Employee Advance

terms.definition: Post a return payment recovering unspent Employee Advance funds back to the company.
terms.label: Return Employee Advance

terms.definition: Submit an approved Travel Request authorizing business travel and estimated expenses.
terms.label: Submit Travel Request

terms.definition: Record candidate acceptance of a submitted Job Offer, unlocking appointment issuance, onboarding, and employee creation.
terms.label: Accept Job Offer

terms.definition: Issue a formal Appointment Letter to an accepted candidate recording contractual joining terms.
terms.label: Issue Appointment Letter

terms.definition: Submit an Employee Onboarding record to spawn joining checklist tasks and activate employment.
terms.label: Submit Employee Onboarding

terms.definition: Submit an Employee Separation record to spawn offboarding clearance tasks and exit settlement.
terms.label: Submit Employee Separation

terms.definition: Submit a finalized Appraisal locking KRA, goal, and feedback scores for the cycle.
terms.label: Submit Appraisal

terms.definition: Submit a Training Result recording completed hours and grades for training attendees.
terms.label: Submit Training Result

terms.definition: Refuses assigning a Department's parent to itself or one of its descendants.
terms.label: Cyclic department hierarchy

terms.definition: Refuses submitting promotions, transfers, or operational HR documents for a separated or inactive employee.
terms.label: Inactive employee mutation

terms.definition: Refuses assigning an employee as their own reporting manager or forming a reporting cycle.
terms.label: Self-reporting manager

terms.definition: Refuses a Leave Application when requested days exceed available balance (unless negative balance is allowed).
terms.label: Insufficient leave balance

terms.definition: Refuses overlapping Leave Applications for the same employee.
terms.label: Overlapping leave application

terms.definition: Refuses a Leave Application spanning dates covered by an applicable Leave Block List unless allowed.
terms.label: Blocked leave date

terms.definition: Refuses overlapping Leave Allocations for the same employee and Leave Type.
terms.label: Overlapping leave allocation

terms.definition: Refuses a requester attempting to approve their own Leave Application.
terms.label: Self-approved leave application

terms.definition: Refuses Leave Encashment when the Leave Type disallows encashment or balance falls below threshold.
terms.label: Ineligible leave encashment

terms.definition: Refuses overlapping Shift Assignments for the same employee.
terms.label: Overlapping shift assignment

terms.definition: Refuses posting more than one active Attendance record for the same employee on the same date.
terms.label: Duplicate daily attendance

terms.definition: Refuses posting working Attendance that contradicts an approved full-day Leave Application on the same date.
terms.label: Attendance conflicts with approved leave

terms.definition: Refuses overlapping submitted Salary Slips for the same employee in the same pay period.
terms.label: Overlapping salary slip

terms.definition: Refuses submitting a Salary Slip whose total deductions exceed gross pay.
terms.label: Negative net pay

terms.definition: Refuses overlapping Payroll Periods within the same company.
terms.label: Overlapping payroll period

terms.definition: Refuses tax exemption declarations or proof submissions exceeding statutory category caps.
terms.label: Tax exemption cap exceeded

terms.definition: Refuses generating a Salary Slip when no active Salary Structure Assignment exists for the pay period.
terms.label: Missing salary structure assignment

terms.definition: Refuses approving an Expense Claim whose sanctioned amount exceeds the claimed amount.
terms.label: Sanctioned exceeds claimed expense

terms.definition: Refuses an employee attempting to approve their own Expense Claim.
terms.label: Self-approved expense claim

terms.definition: Refuses offsetting more Employee Advance funds than remain unclaimed from the paid advance.
terms.label: Employee advance over-allocation

terms.definition: Refuses initiating Employee Onboarding from a Job Offer that has not been accepted.
terms.label: Onboarding without accepted offer

terms.definition: Refuses creating or submitting multiple active Appraisals for the same employee in one Appraisal Cycle.
terms.label: Duplicate appraisal in cycle

terms.definition: Refuses Appraisal KRA or Goal weightages whose sum violates the 100% allocation bound.
terms.label: Goal or KRA weightage overflow

terms.definition: Flags or refuses completing Employee Separation while unrecovered advances, assets, or final settlement remain open.
terms.label: Unsettled separation obligations
